name: Drawphone
tagline: Draw a word, pass it on, guess what they drew. Telephone with pictures.
description:
Someone draws a word. The next person guesses what the drawing is. The next person draws that guess. Around it goes, and at the end a moon has become a pancake — or a cat a hat. There is no winning. The point is the chain.

Press Play with friends and send the invite. Everyone who opens it sits at the same table. There is no game server and no code to type: the invite is the room. The host starts when two or more people are in. Each person writes only their own turn. Draw with a finger or a mouse.

Or pass this device around a table. Add names, start, and hand the phone to whoever is up.

An unofficial port of Drawphone by Tanner Krewson. The original needs a game server. This copy does not: the meeting is the room.
